WITH claim_loss AS (
  SELECT c."Insurable_Object_Identifier" AS io_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN lp."Claim_Amount_Identifier" IS NOT NULL THEN ca."Claim_Amount" ELSE 0 END)
       + SUM(CASE WHEN lr."Claim_Amount_Identifier" IS NOT NULL THEN ca."Claim_Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS incurred_loss
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" c
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" ca
    ON ca."Claim_Identifier" = c."Claim_Identifier"
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" lp
    ON lp."Claim_Amount_Identifier" = ca."Claim_Amount_Identifier"
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" lr
    ON lr."Claim_Amount_Identifier" = ca."Claim_Amount_Identifier"
  GROUP BY c."Insurable_Object_Identifier"
),
premium AS (
  SELECT pcd."Insurable_Object_Identifier" AS io_id,
         SUM(pa."Policy_Amount") AS premium_charged
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" pcd
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" pa
    ON pa."Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier" = pcd."Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier"
   AND pa."Effective_Date" = pcd."Effective_Date"
  GROUP BY pcd."Insurable_Object_Identifier"
),
io_addr AS (
  SELECT io."Insurable_Object_Identifier" AS io_id,
         la."Location_Address_Identifier" AS addr_id,
         la."Line_1_Address" AS street_address
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."insurable_object" io
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."geographic_location" gl
    ON gl."Geographic_Location_Identifier" = io."Geographic_Location_Identifier"
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."location_address" la
    ON la."Location_Address_Identifier" = gl."Location_Address_Identifier"
)
SELECT
  a.addr_id AS location_address_id,
  a.street_address,
  SUM(cl.incurred_loss) AS incurred_loss,
  SUM(COALESCE(p.premium_charged, 0)) AS premium_charged,
  SUM(cl.incurred_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(p.premium_charged, 0)), 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM claim_loss cl
JOIN io_addr a ON a.io_id = cl.io_id
LEFT JOIN premium p ON p.io_id = cl.io_id
GROUP BY a.addr_id, a.street_address
ORDER BY loss_ratio DESC
LIMIT 500
